arguments.command:
python3 -c "
import parse

# Create expected
tz60 = parse.FixedTzOffset(60, '+01:00')

# Parse +0100
r = parse.parse('a {:ti} b', 'a 1997-07-16T19:20+0100 b')
print('Parsed +0100:')
print('  datetime:', r.fixed[0])
print('  tzinfo:', r.fixed[0].tzinfo)
print('  tzname:', r.fixed[0].tzinfo.tzname(None))

# Compare
print()
print('Expected tz60:', tz60)
print('Are they equal?', r.fixed[0].tzinfo == tz60)
"
